# Completed GitHub Actions Research Workflows

These manual-only workflows were moved out of `.github/workflows` after their research stages completed. Scheduled, automatic, push-triggered, and reusable workflows are intentionally preserved in the active folder. Archiving preserves exact historical workflow definitions in Git while reducing Actions UI clutter.

The underlying committed research artifacts and manifests remain in their original repository locations.

Each archived workflow's original path and SHA-256 are recorded in `archive_manifest.json`. To restore a workflow, move the exact file back to `.github/workflows/`; its contents were not modified.
